from pathlib import Path
from sqlalchemy import text
from agentforge.settings import get_settings
from agentforge.database.engine import create_db_engine
s=get_settings(); path=Path('.env')
ignored=subprocess.run(['git','check-ignore','--quiet',str(path.resolve())]).returncode==0
if not ignored:raise SystemExit('API env is not ignored; stopped.')

e.dispose()
